blurb: Guests can visit tasting rooms in Vancouver and Calgary to enjoy a variety of craft beers on tap or to go. The brewery offers private event bookings with food options and minimum spend requirements. They ship beer via Canada Post or Purolator and do not fill growlers at this time.
extraNote: No reservations for Vancouver tasting rooms; walk-in basis with bar service · Calgary tasting room accepts reservations via email calgary@33acresbrewing.com · Events cancelled within 30 days charged 50% of minimum spend; within 14 days charged 100% · Tasting rooms at 33A - 15 West 8th Ave, 33B - 25 West 8th Ave, Vancouver; 33C - #120 224 12 Ave SW, Calgary
